_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Dwelling Walls#000.src: I left a very precious journal inside of this mansion, a hell within walls. It was my great grandfather's!
Dwelling Walls#000.dst: Deixei um diário muito precioso dentro desta mansão, um inferno entre paredes. Era do meu bisavô!
Dwelling Walls#000.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#002.src: Let's see here... mother's old vase... check!
Dwelling Walls#002.dst: Vamos ver... o vaso antigo da mamãe... ok!
Dwelling Walls#002.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#003.src: Dining room table... got it here, check!
Dwelling Walls#003.dst: Mesa da sala de jantar... está aqui, ok!
Dwelling Walls#003.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#004.src: Finally, the journal. It's out here somewhere, I assume. I'll look around.
Dwelling Walls#004.dst: Por fim, o diário. Deve estar por aqui em algum lugar. Vou dar uma olhada.
Dwelling Walls#004.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#006.src: Hold on, what? The journal! I must have forgotten it inside the mansion!
Dwelling Walls#006.dst: Espere, o quê? O diário! Devo ter esquecido dentro da mansão!
Dwelling Walls#006.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#007.src: You there! Would you mind doing me a deed?
Dwelling Walls#007.dst: Ei, você! Poderia me fazer um favor?
Dwelling Walls#007.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#008.src: The mansion was designed by a Corkian architect, and I was scammed into buying it.
Dwelling Walls#008.dst: A mansão foi projetada por um arquiteto Corkian, e me enganaram para comprá-la.
Dwelling Walls#008.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#009.src: If you step inside the mansion just for a few moments, you'll understand why the sellers had to trick someone into investing in their god forsaken real estate!
Dwelling Walls#009.dst: Se você entrar na mansão nem que seja por um instante, vai entender por que os vendedores tiveram que enganar alguém para investir nesse imóvel amaldiçoado!
Dwelling Walls#009.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#010.src: Navigating from room to room is nearly impossible, the rooms move around. I've only been in the mansion for a week and I'm already packing my bags and moving to {p}.
Dwelling Walls#010.dst: Andar de um cômodo a outro é quase impossível, os cômodos se mexem. Estou na mansão há só uma semana e já estou de malas prontas para me mudar para {p}.
Dwelling Walls#010.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#012.src: Navigate the mansion to the room holding the journal
Dwelling Walls#012.dst: Percorra a mansão até o cômodo com o diário

Dwelling Walls#014.src: The journal! You outsmarted the mansion!
Dwelling Walls#014.dst: O diário! Você passou a perna na mansão!
Dwelling Walls#014.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#015.src: I must thank you, that journal was priceless to my family.
Dwelling Walls#015.dst: Obrigado! Esse diário não tinha preço pra minha família.
Dwelling Walls#015.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#016.src: Let this be a life lesson to you. Never buy a house from a Corkian architect.
Dwelling Walls#016.dst: Que isso te sirva de lição. Nunca compre uma casa de um arquiteto Corkian.
Dwelling Walls#016.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#017.src:
{#} [{~}/{~}] Leucsaa: Hey, you can't just barge in there!
{#} You'd get lost, trust me.
Dwelling Walls#017.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#018.src: Have you gotten [{~} Leucsaa's Journal] yet from the mansion? I don't blame you, it's an udder nightmare!
Dwelling Walls#018.dst: Já pegou o [{~} Leucsaa's Journal] na mansão? Não te culpo, é um pesadelo de muuuita encrenca!
Dwelling Walls#018.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#019.src: You should find a way to reach the journal.

Dwelling Walls#020.src: With the journal found, you should take it and bring it to Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#021.src: Grab the journal and exit the mansion

Dwelling Walls#022.src: Thank you for retrieving my journal from the mansion, I hope nobody else is tricked into buying this evil piece of property!
Dwelling Walls#022.speaker: Leucsaa
